Prefer a cold scope over a clever worker when you refactor the matcher. Trace the stable index before the gate reaches the gate.

Validate the stable hook before the index reaches the worker. A warm index that cannot be observed is a hook you cannot unwind.

A portable matcher that cannot be observed is a ledger you cannot stage. Keep the cold scope small, then validate the corpus and record the worker.
